performance.verdict: $614 spent, zero leads in 28 days — attribution is broken, not ads.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: 28 days, $613.56 spent across 128 Google clicks, zero leads recorded. CPL is undefined — the funnel has no measurable output at all.
Overdue SOW milestone: Stripe Products QA was marked Done on 2026-07-20 but no completed-event record matches — payment path verification is unconfirmed.
GHL pipeline disconnect: 136 opportunities created in 28 days with 0 leads attributed to ads — intake pipeline exists but ads-to-CRM attribution is not firing, an intake leak not an ads failure.
GBP actions collapsed 93.75% week-over-week, from ~16 to 1 action; last 3 days show 0 GBP actions vs a prior-3-day average of ~0.3 — local profile visibility is effectively dead.
Search clicks dropped 42.86% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 26–28) average 0 sc_clicks vs prior 3-day average of 2.3 — organic search intent is decelerating alongside paid.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads conversion action and GHL lead source tagging — 128 clicks, $613.56 spent, zero leads means tracking is broken.
suggestions.monday_update: Run a test conversion through the Google Ads call campaign ('BWS - Search Campaign - Calls', $344.71 of the $613.56 spend) and confirm it surfaces as a lead in GHL with the correct source attribution. The 136 opportunities already in GHL suggest contacts are arriving, meaning the ads-to-lead attribution link — not the funnel itself — is likely broken. Success is defined as at least one end-to-end test lead appearing in GHL with a Google source tag within 48 hours. Re-check by 2026-09-01.

suggestions.text: Verify Stripe Products QA milestone: run one live payment path per the SOW and document the completed-event record.
suggestions.monday_update: The Stripe Products QA milestone was logged as Done on 2026-07-20 but no verified completion record exists in the system. Complete one end-to-end dummy transaction through each intake path (WordPress/Stripe webhook + GHL Products Payment - BWS) and confirm both create exactly one opportunity, fully field-mapped. Success is a dated completion record acknowledged by Nacer. Target: 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions recovery; hold any organic scaling until 3-day average exceeds 2 actions/day.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for the last 3 days (Aug 26–28) after a 93.75% week-over-week drop, and search clicks averaged 0 over the same window. No paid action is warranted until tracking (S1) is confirmed clean and GBP recovers to at least 2 actions/day average over 3 consecutive days. Re-check on 2026-09-01 with the next 3-day window.
